posts.author: shrimpexperiment
posts.body: Hello hello! I'm Shrimp! I've been into digital art for 10 years and I got into rpg maker games around 2018 and have adored them since. I first bought 2003 then upgraded to mv! I haven't made anything significant in the programs I do have but I hope making a forum post gets me into the grove of things. I'm not normally a forum person, but I think this will make it significantly easier to ask for help or look for resources in general!
